title: tx402 shared definitions
description: Primitive definitions shared by every tx402 schema. Frozen at M0 (PLAN.md session S2): changing any pattern here is a wire-visible change and requires an ADR.

caip2.title: CAIP-2 network identifier
caip2.description: Canonical, fully-qualified network identifier. Solana identifiers are the 32-character truncated genesis hash, never the `solana:mainnet` alias — see ADR-010 decision 4. Aliases are resolved to this form before any comparison.

caip2OrAlias.title: CAIP-2 identifier or manifest-declared alias
caip2OrAlias.description: Accepted at the configuration boundary only (`policy.allowedNetworks`, `routing.preferNetworks`, CLI `--network`). Normalized to `caip2` before route matching, health indexing, or diagnostics.

caip19.title: CAIP-19 asset identifier
caip19.description: Derived, never parsed from the wire. EVM: `<caip2>/erc20:<address>`. SVM: `<caip2>/token:<mint>`.

atomicAmount.title: Non-negative integer atomic units
atomicAmount.description: Base-10 string, no sign, no leading zeros, no decimal point, no exponent. ADR-006: money is never a JS number or a Python float, and never crosses a language boundary as one.

sha256Digest.title: Prefixed SHA-256 digest
sha256Digest.description: Lowercase hex with an explicit algorithm prefix so the hash function is never inferred. Used for diagnostics and idempotency only, never as authorization material (SPEC §5.1).

uuidV7.title: UUIDv7
uuidV7.description: Time-ordered UUID. Used for reservation IDs and the non-authoritative X-TX402-REQUEST-ID diagnostic header.

rfc3339.title: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp
rfc3339.description: Always UTC with an explicit `Z`. Local offsets are rejected so that two implementations cannot disagree about ordering.

resourceUrl.title: Absolute resource URL
resourceUrl.description: HTTPS by default (SEC-004). `http://` is permitted only for loopback hosts and only when the client is constructed with `allowInsecureLocalhost: true`.

scheme.title: x402 payment scheme
scheme.description: v0.1 implements `exact` only. Any other value raises UnsupportedSchemeError; it is never heuristically coerced (ADR-004).

errorCode.title: tx402 error code
errorCode.description: The complete taxonomy from SPEC §8. Frozen at M0. Adding a code is a minor release; changing or removing one is a breaking change (SPEC §15).

errorClassName.title: tx402 error class name
errorClassName.description: Identical in TypeScript and Python (ADR-005). Bound one-to-one to `errorCode`.

retryability.title: Retry classification
retryability.description: Verbatim classification of the SPEC §8 `Retryable` column. The boolean `Tx402Error.retryable` is derived from it: true only for `caller-policy`. See ADR-011.

phase.title: Request-execution phase
phase.description: SPEC §8 Tx402ErrorContext.phase. Maps onto the SPEC §6 state machine.

errorContext.title: Tx402ErrorContext
errorContext.description: The common diagnostic envelope carried by every tx402 error (SPEC §8). Per-error specifics live in `details`, not here — see ADR-011.

paid.description: `"unknown"` is a distinct third state, not a missing boolean — it is what AmbiguousPaymentError reports (SPEC §6.7).

environment.title: Network environment
environment.description: Production and test networks MUST NOT be mixed in one selected route (SPEC §5.4). Test networks require explicit config opt-in.
